danger.title: Replace or delete data
danger.text: Deletes all the family’s data: accounts and balances, flows, loans, real estate, goals, members, currencies, parameters, closed months, the advisor’s proposals and the change history. Kept: the family language and currency, the users and their rights, the Telegram link, the advisor’s days to decide and to remind and the downloaded exchange rates. This cannot be undone. Download a database copy first. Afterwards the setup wizard runs again.
danger.confirmText: Everything listed on the page is deleted at once; only a database copy can bring it back. To confirm, type {{word}}.

demo.confirmText: First everything now in the app is deleted (accounts, flows, loans, real estate, goals, members, users and the change history), then the fictional family is written. Everyone else signs in again with the family password. Only a database copy can bring the current data back. To confirm, type {{word}}.
demo.confirmTextPlain: The example family brings its own members and currencies; the language is the one you chose. Everyone else signs in again with the family password.
demo.confirmTelegram: Sign-in through Telegram ends: afterwards everyone enters with the family password, and the accounts in the app are gone. The bot stays connected.
